Atributo.Reduzido: Attribute reduced until the end of the scene
Atributo.Aumentado: {atributo} {base} → {dado} until the end of the scene

Pericia.Rolar: Click to roll · Shift to open the dialog
Pericia.Dica: The paired attribute is a suggestion — swap it in the check dialog.
Pericia.AbrirDialogo: Open the check dialog — attribute, steps and abilities

Campo.NexAjuda: NEX is the paranormal progression track. No published mechanic yet in the playtest; the field is here for when it ships.

Recurso.Ajuda: Describe the use to the table. The GM decides whether it fits and what it does — the suggested default is one step up on the check at hand.
Recurso.SemItens: This character has no abilities, equipment or tools to use.
Recurso.Conceder: Grant +1 step on the next check
Recurso.Concedido: {ator} received +{passos} step(s) on the next check.

Habilidade.Vazio: No abilities yet. A character starts with two: one from the profile, one from the calling.
Habilidade.EfeitoAjuda: Only what the engine can apply. Narrative effects belong in the description.
Habilidade.DadoExtraAjuda: Counts against the cap of 4 dice rolled per check.
Habilidade.PermitirD20Ajuda: Only explicit paranormal effects go past d12. Out of scope for the playtest.
Habilidade.UsoEmInvestigacaoAjuda: The playtest's suggested default is one step up on the check at hand.
Habilidade.ImpetoAjuda: The bar shows on this ability's card in the sheet. Deleting the ability deletes the bar with it.
Habilidade.PdAoDescobrirAjuda: When Examine reveals new information, the character recovers this many PD ("Amor pela Descoberta"). Zero = it does not.

Equipamento.ArmaAjuda: Wielding a weapon makes melee damage use the High Roll instead of the Low Roll.
Equipamento.ArmaduraDica: conta quando o item está equipado
Equipamento.Escudo: Escudo (reduz a RB do dano quando perde com 7+)

Npc.PericiasAjuda: NPCs don't use the full list: declare only the skills this NPC actually uses.
Npc.SemPericias: No skills declared. Add only the ones this NPC actually uses.

POI.DescricaoBasicaAjuda: Narrated the first time someone investigates this point of interest.
POI.QuadroAjuda: Investigate compares the die size against the DT, without rolling. Examine rolls and compares the sum.
POI.DescricaoContextualAjuda: The full explanation. It resolves the players' freeform interactions.
POI.FerramentasAjuda: Empty = normal reading, no reaction. A normal reading is also information — only reveal it after they investigate.
POI.FerramentasVazio: No tools configured on this POI.
POI.RadioFrasePlaceholder: Pieces in order, separated by | (or words separated by spaces)
POI.RadioAjudaAutor: Mark the false ones. The Technology test removes some of them; the player sees every piece shuffled together, orders the right ones and discards the rest.
POI.SomenteMestre: The information board and the contextual description are GM-only.

Visibilidade.rascunho: Draft — players can't see it and Examine never finds it. Click to make it discoverable.
Visibilidade.descobrivel: Discoverable — only by Examining with the skill and meeting the DT. Click to open it to everyone.
Visibilidade.aberta: Open — every player sees it without spending an action. Click to return to draft.

POI.LaboratorioDadosAjuda: How many dice the Lab ladder rolls at this point (4 to 6) — the book's "minimum sequence". The app uses it as the default.
POI.RadioTextoAjuda: What the radio does when there is no sentence to assemble (a scream, static). With sets registered, the puzzle takes priority.
POI.DesafiosAjuda: Drag an Access Challenge here. Linking the point to an investigation brings its challenges along.

Acoes.Ajuda: Opens this character's investigation actions — investigate, examine, tools, challenges.
Acoes.SemInvestigacao: No investigation in play for this character. The GM needs to put one in play and add you as a participant.
Acoes.SemPOIs: No points of interest available yet.
Acoes.SemAliado: Target someone on the map, or add another character to the investigation.
Acoes.SemAlvo: Target someone on the map, or add someone to the investigation.

Investigacao.NadaNovo: No new information with this skill.
Investigacao.ExaminarSemInfo: The examination revealed no new information.
Investigacao.PDPago: {ator} lost {custo} DP examining without finding anything.
Investigacao.RecapitularAviso: Roleplay the recap of everything the group has found. If the GM deems it coherent, make an Insight check (DT {dt}). After a success, Recap locks for the group in this scene.
Investigacao.RecapitularSucesso: {ator} recapped the investigation. The GM may grant a new clue — registering locks the action for the group in this scene.
Investigacao.CompartilharAjuda: The ally rolls the Share skill (DT {dt}) as a free action.
Investigacao.CompartilharTexto: {ator} explains a clue from this scene to {aliado}.
Investigacao.CompartilharSucesso: {aliado} understood {ator}'s explanation and may deduce a new clue — registering locks Share for the group in this scene.
Investigacao.TravaRegistrada: {acao} is locked for the group until the end of the scene.
Investigacao.AcaoTravada: This action already succeeded in this scene.
Investigacao.SemAliados: No other character in the scene to receive the clue.
Investigacao.EmJogoAjuda: In-play investigations show up in the navigator of the players who are part of them. The group can be in more than one at once.
Investigacao.SemPoisAjuda: No points of interest. Drag a Point of Interest item here.
Investigacao.SemDesafiosAjuda: No challenges. Drag a Challenge item here.
Investigacao.ExaminarEscolhaAjuda: Examining hands over everything with DT up to your die size for free, then rolls for the rest. If nothing comes up, it costs {custo} PD.

SemRevelacao.sem-pericia: There's nothing here that {pericia} can reach.
SemRevelacao.dado-pequeno: There's something here for {pericia}, but your {dado} doesn't reach it. A bigger die — or help — would change that.
SemRevelacao.ja-revelado: You've already found everything {pericia} reaches here.

Investigacao.DtQueFaltava: GM: the lowest remaining DT for this skill is {dt}.
Investigacao.ExaminarAchou: the roll revealed {quantidade} new pieces of information.
Investigacao.ExaminarSoGratis: {quantidade} lines came without rolling: their DC is within the size of your die.
Investigacao.CriticoExaminar: reveals what was left for this skill, ignoring the DT.
Investigacao.InteragirDica: Act on the point with no test. The GM narrates what happens.
Investigacao.InteragirAguarde: No test. The GM narrates what happens.
Investigacao.InteragirSoMestre: Only you can see this — the contextual description is the GM's. Narrate the outcome to the table.
Investigacao.InteragirSemContextual: This point has no contextual description. Narrate by common sense.
Investigacao.ExaminarGratisTambem: {quantidade} more lines came without rolling (DC within the size of your die).
Investigacao.ExaminarRestante: The roll ({total}) did not reach what is still left for this skill.
Investigacao.ExaminarNadaMais: Nothing left for this skill at this point.
Investigacao.ExaminarAchouUma: the roll revealed one new piece of information.
Investigacao.ExaminarSoGratisUma: one line came without rolling: its DC is within the size of your die.
Investigacao.ExaminarGratisTambemUma: One more line came without rolling (DC within the size of your die).
Investigacao.ContarAoGrupoAjuda: Makes this clue visible to every participant of the investigation, with your name. The Share action is still something else: the ally's test for a new clue.
Investigacao.ContadaVisivel: The clue now shows on every participant's panel.
Investigacao.ContarSoQuemAchou: Only whoever found the clue can tell it to the group.

Teste.AtributoAjuda: The base attribute is a suggestion. The GM may call for a different one.
Teste.AvisoSelecao: You'll roll more dice than you can add — you'll pick which 3 count.
Teste.CustoPD: Costs {custo} DP, charged when you roll.

Selecao.Intro: Up to 4 dice are rolled, but only 3 make the result.
Selecao.Incompleto: Pick more dice to complete the result.
Selecao.Dica: The highest sum isn't always best: the High and Low Rolls drive damage, forcing and climbing.

Pericia.TrocaAtributo: The paired attribute is a suggestion — you can swap it in the check dialog, after picking the skill.
Pericia.SemRolagem: Investigate rolls no dice: it compares your die size against the information's DT. Picking resolves it.

OP2.CriticoExplica: succeeds automatically and yields extra information while investigating

FalhaCritica.DecisaoDoMestre: If the effect doesn't fit the situation, the GM picks another.

vexame.texto: Narrate the action in a humiliating way. No mechanical effect.

machucado.texto: Physical steps down until the end of the scene.

desatencao.texto: Mind steps down until the end of the scene.

irritacao.texto: Emotion steps down until the end of the scene.

perda.texto: Lose a carried item or a purchase slot. The GM decides which.

Chat.DanoNosSelecionados: Applies to the tokens selected on the scene; with no selection, to whoever rolled.
Chat.FalhaCriticaExplica: All dice on 1: roll 1d8 on the critical failure table (spec §4.4). The GM decides the effect.

Cena.Encerrada: Scene ended. Temporary reductions cleared for {total} character(s).
Cena.SemPersonagens: No characters in the active scene.

Painel.SemPersonagem: Assign a character to your user to act in the investigation.
Painel.SemPOIs: No points of interest in this scene. The GM can drag a Point of Interest here.
Painel.AbrirPOI: Open the point of interest sheet
Painel.ExaminarDica: Rolls the skill against the DT. If nothing new is revealed, lose 1 DP.
Painel.OrdemAjuda: Players decide the order among themselves; the GM drags. NPCs always act last.
Painel.SobrecargaAjuda: Emotional damage at the end of each round. The last row applies to every round after it.
Painel.SemDesafios: No challenge in this scene. The GM can drag a Challenge item here.
Painel.SemInvestigacaoAjudaGM: Pick an existing investigation or create a new one. Round, mental strain, participants and the Recap/Share locks belong to the investigation, not the Scene — an investigation can span several maps.
Painel.SemInvestigacaoAjudaJogador: Your character isn't part of any in-play investigation right now. Ask the GM to add you as a participant.
Painel.SemParticipantes: No one in the investigation yet. Drag an Actor here.
Painel.ParticipantesAjuda: Who's part of the investigation, not who has a token on the Scene — drag characters and NPCs from anywhere.
Painel.JaAgiuAjuda: The GM checks off who has already acted this round — manual tracking, the system doesn't pass turns on its own. Clears when the round advances.
Painel.PreparacaoAjuda: Investigation setup: who takes part, the events with their own script and mental overload. Drag actors, points, challenges and events onto the panel.
Painel.IrParaDesafio: Go to the challenge on the Challenges tab
Painel.EventoNestaRodada: A scripted event falls on this round.

Filtro.IntocadosDica: No line of the board has reached anyone
Filtro.EmAndamentoDica: Some line has reached someone, and some remain
Filtro.ComPistasDica: Some line has already reached you
Filtro.EsgotadosDica: Every line (drafts aside) has reached someone
Filtro.NoMapaDica: With a marker on the open scene
Filtro.SemMarcadorDica: No marker on the open scene — still to be placed

Painel.SemPOIsMestre: No points of interest in this investigation. Use "Create point of interest" above, or drag a point-of-interest Item from the Items tab here.

Rodada.SobrecargaTexto: End of round {encerrada}: {dano} emotional damage (DP). Each player rolls their own.
Rodada.SemDano: End of round {encerrada}: no overload damage.

Aviso.TetoDeDados: At most {max} dice rolled per check.
Aviso.AptidaoDuplicada: An Aptitude field named "{rotulo}" already exists.
Aviso.AtorAusente: The character for this card no longer exists.
Aviso.SemPermissao: This button belongs to another player or to the GM.
Aviso.SemMestreOnline: No GM online to record the result. Call the GM and try again.

dtPadrao.name: Default DT
dtPadrao.hint: The difficulty the playtest suggests when none is given.

escopoCritico.name: Critical looks at
escopoCritico.hint: The playtest doesn't say whether discarded dice count toward a critical. The default scans every rolled die.

compartilharPericia.name: Share check skill
compartilharPericia.hint: The body text says Research; the summary table says Insight. The default follows the normative text.

ajudaAlvo.name: Help steps up
ajudaAlvo.hint: The text doesn't say which die receives the step up from the Help action.

falhaTrauma.name: Failed trauma check
falhaTrauma.hint: The playtest warns that dying from DP loss won't be this easy in the final version.

idiomaPadraoPtBR.name: Default the interface to Portuguese
idiomaPadraoPtBR.hint: Players who have not picked a language yet start in pt-BR. An explicit choice is always respected.

cliqueAbreDialogo.name: Click opens the check dialog
cliqueAbreDialogo.hint: By default a click rolls directly and Shift opens the dialog. Enable to swap them.

boasVindas.name: Welcome on entering
boasVindas.hint: Shows the welcome screen (what the system brings, playtest adventures, license) to the GM when entering the world. "About and license" opens the same screen anytime.

Desafio.MaxTentativasAjuda: 0 = no limit. Only locks tend to have a cap in the playtest.
Desafio.Quebrado: Broken (only a key will do now)
Desafio.JaQuebrado: This challenge is already broken — it can't be forced open anymore.
Desafio.Quebrou: Ran out of attempts and broke. Only a key will do now.
Desafio.SustentarSoltou: {ator} couldn't take it anymore and let go.
Desafio.JaDestrancado: This lock has already been picked.
Desafio.SenhaAusente: The GM hasn't generated this lock's code yet.
Desafio.HackEsperaRodada: Already tried this round — wait for the next one.
Desafio.HackTecnicoAjudaMestre: The test passed. No table on this panel: read a problem aloud, reveal it with the countdown, or mark it solved.
Desafio.HackSocialChances: {chances} chance(s) to get it wrong · {necessarias} correct answer(s) needed.
Desafio.HackTimerAjuda: The countdown opens on everyone's screen. ▶ on a band reveals its problem; the standalone button only counts time for a problem read aloud.
Desafio.AbordagensAjuda: Check only what makes sense on this object. A jammed door can't be hacked; an electronic panel can't be forced open.
Desafio.SemAbordagem: No approach checked on this challenge — the GM needs to pick at least one on its sheet.
Desafio.SenhaAjuda: The code is generated here, or on its own at the first Unlock attempt. Generating another resets the history.
Desafio.GenericoAjuda: For what the playtest doesn't name: boarded-up planks, a rusted gate, a high window. Pick the skill and the name shown on the button.
Desafio.GenericoJaResolvido: This challenge was already beaten with that approach.
Desafio.HackTecnicoSemFaixa: The panel gave nothing back — you can try again next round.
Desafio.HackTabelaAjuda: With the table filled in, the test opens nothing: the total picks the band, you get the problem and the answer, reveal it to the table and give the verdict.
Desafio.DestrancarTetoRodada: That's all {teto} attempt(s) for this round (Crime {dado}). Wait for the next one.
Desafio.DestrancarLegenda: ✓ exact · ↓ high: lower this number · ↑ low: raise this number
Desafio.DestrancarSenhaAuto: The code is generated on the first attempt ({tamanho} positions from 1 to {faces}). Generating another resets the history.
Desafio.ArrombarSucesso: the RA ({ra}) is added to the score.
Desafio.ArrombarFalha: did not reach DC {dt}; the score does not advance.
Desafio.ArrombarCritico: the RA ({ra}) is added to the score, ignoring the DC.
Desafio.SenhaNaFicha: The code and the history live on the challenge sheet.
Desafio.HackAguardaMestre: Technology: {total}. The GM prepares the problem — get ready.
Desafio.HackMestrePreparar: Technology {total}, band {faixa}: {segundos} seconds for the problem below. Announce the time, ask if they are ready, then reveal.
Desafio.HackIniciar: Reveal the problem and start the countdown
Desafio.HackProblemaOral: The GM reads the problem aloud.
Desafio.HackAcertouTexto: {ator} solved the problem — the panel opened.
Desafio.HackErrouTexto: {ator} got it wrong — try again next round.
Desafio.SenhaManual: Senha manual e dado de cada posição
Desafio.SenhaManualAjuda: Escolha o dado de cada posição (ex.: d8 + d6 + d12). "Salvar só os dados" mantém o sorteio automático com esses dados; "Salvar senha digitada" usa os valores que você escreveu (zera o histórico).
Desafio.SenhaManualInvalida: Preencha todas as posições com valores dentro do dado de cada uma.
Desafio.NovoTipoAjuda: Que tipo de desafio você quer criar?

CategoriaAjuda.equilibrio: Travessia: o personagem rola 2d10 por rodada e usa dados de equilíbrio (metade da Acrobacia).
CategoriaAjuda.sustentar: Alguém segura o obstáculo (Atletismo, 1 PV) enquanto os outros passam; o teste se repete a cada rodada, cada vez mais difícil.
CategoriaAjuda.alcancar: Alcançar algo de difícil acesso: seguro (dois testes de Acrobacia) ou arriscado (um teste, DT +3). Usa a DT do objeto.

Desafio.SoltarParaContinuar: You are holding {nome}. Let go to take this action?
Desafio.NadaSustentado: This character is not holding anything.
Desafio.SustentarComoContinua: At the end of each round, test Athletics again (with fatigue). Use Let go when the group no longer needs it.

Ferramenta.CargasAjuda: Only the UV Flash Light (3) and the Revealing Powder (5) have limited charges in the playtest; the rest are unlimited.
Ferramenta.LaserMarcou: The Scanning Laser found a reaction at:
Ferramenta.LaserNada: No new point of interest reacted to other tools.
Ferramenta.LaserDica: The Scanning Laser detected a reaction to some tool here.
Ferramenta.LaboratorioAjuda: {ator} rolls the ladder: each die must be equal to or higher than the last. Aptitude (Exact Sciences) {aptidao} is the ceiling.
Ferramenta.LaboratorioValido: Valid sequence — the Lab delivers the reading.
Ferramenta.LaboratorioQuebrou: The sequence broke somewhere along the way.
Ferramenta.QtdDados: How many dice the POI requires (4 to 6)
Ferramenta.RadioSemConjuntos: This point of interest has no sets configured for the Modified Radio.
Ferramenta.RadioAjuda: Technology test: {total}. Removed {removidos} of {totalFalsos} false set(s). Order the pieces into the right sentence and discard the ones that don't belong.
Ferramenta.RadioTudoRemovido: The test removed every false set and no piece is left to order.
Ferramenta.RadioResolvido: The pieces form the right sentence.
Ferramenta.RadioNaoResolvido: The order (or the discards) does not match the right sentence.

Ferimento.Texto: {ator} chegou a 0 PV. Teste de Físico + {pericia} contra DT {dt}.
Ferimento.Consequencia: Crítico: recupera 1 PV. Sucesso: inconsciente e moribundo. Falha: tabela de Lesões. Falha crítica: morre.
Ferimento.ProximaDT: The next check will be against DT {dt}.

Resultado.Critico: {ator} recupera 1 PV e se recupera de inconsciente e moribundo.
Resultado.Falha: {ator} sofre uma lesão: role na tabela de Lesões.

Trauma.Texto: {ator} chegou a 0 PD. Teste de Emoção + {pericia} contra DT {dt}.

Falha.morte: {ator} suffers a mental collapse and dies.
Falha.colapso: {ator} suffers a mental collapse and leaves the scene.

Trauma.Consequencia: Sucesso: nenhum efeito. Falha: tabela de Traumas.

Resultado.Falha: {ator} sofre um trauma: role na tabela de Traumas.

Ajuda.Aliado: Who you help (target on the map to skip this)
Ajuda.EscolhaAjuda: Pick the skill you help with. It must fit the situation and be at least d6 — a d4 can't help. d6/d8 give +1 step; d10/d12 give +2.
Ajuda.DadoPequeno: Your {pericia} is {dado}: a d4 can't help (rule of the action).
Ajuda.SemAliados: Target someone on the map, or add another character to the investigation.
Ajuda.Card: {ajudante} helps {alvo} with {pericia} ({dado}): +{passos} step(s) on the next check.

Combate.Alvo: Attack target (target on the map to skip this)
Combate.SemAlvos: There is no other character, NPC or creature in the combat, the scene or the investigation to attack.
Combate.ArmadoPergunta: Are you wielding a weapon? Armed, damage is HR; unarmed, LR.
Combate.Venceu: {vencedor} wins the opposed test and deals {dano} damage to {perdedor}.
Combate.Empate: Tie on the opposed check — nobody deals damage.
Combate.FaseAjuda: Em que fase cada um age nesta rodada? Geral (qualquer ação, exceto ataques) → Ataques à distância → Ataques corpo a corpo. Quem age numa fase não age nas seguintes.
Combate.DefendeuTexto: {defensor} defends: takes no damage and deals none.

Impeto.Dica: Each failed check fills one slot. Erase one to get +d4 on a check.
Impeto.PassoDica: Erases the whole bar and raises one attribute by one step until the end of the scene.
Impeto.QualAtributo: Which attribute goes up one step
Impeto.PassoAplicado: {atributo} goes up one step until the end of the scene.
Impeto.Cheia: The momentum bar is already full.
Impeto.AcaoExtraUsada: {nome} gasta 3 espaços de ímpeto: faz uma ação extra nesta cena de conflito.

Ocupacao.Ajuda: Calling (formerly occupation) is free text on the sheet and grants one ability (spec §2.1). Drag this calling onto a character: it fills the field and brings the ability along.
Ocupacao.HabilidadeUuid: Where to pull the ability from

Extras.Intro: “{aventura}” uses images, a map and audio the publisher only hands to people who own the material. They don't ship with the system: they live in your world's folder.
Extras.Pedir: Pick the {zip} file you downloaded from the publisher's site. {faltam} of {total} files are missing from the world folder.
Extras.Destino: Files go to {pasta}. Nothing in the system is changed.
Extras.Enviando: Unpacking and uploading to the world folder…
Extras.Faltando: Not found in the zip (neither by exact name nor by approximation):
Extras.ErroGeral: Could not prepare the adventure files: {erro}
Extras.MenuAjuda: Re-uploads to the world folder the images, map and audio of an adventure the publisher ships as a zip — for anyone who imported without them or changed worlds.
Extras.MenuIntro: System adventures whose art comes from the publisher's zip. Uploads go to this world's folder.
Extras.Aproximados: Found under a different name — check it is the right file:
Extras.ComoCompletar: The adventure will point to those files anyway. When you have them, re-upload through Settings → Adventure files.
Extras.NenhumArquivo: None of the {total} expected files is in {arquivo} ({entradas} file(s) inside it). Is it the right zip?
Extras.AvisoIncompleto: Adventure files: {enviados} of {total} uploaded. See the list in the window.

Evento.FichaAjuda: An event with its own script (the Act I curse). Rounds count from the trigger: round 0 is the moment it is pulled, be it scene round 1 or 50.
Evento.GatilhoAjuda: What starts the event. The GM decides it happened, from the panel.
Evento.RoteiroAjuda: Round 0 is the trigger. The narration goes to the round card; the effect is GM-only.
Evento.SemRodadas: No rounds in the script yet.
Evento.EstadoDisparado: Triggered on scene round {rodada} — now it is event round {relativa}.
Evento.DispararAjuda: The trigger happened: the current round becomes round 0 of this event.
Evento.SemEventos: No events in this investigation. Drag an Event here or create one.
Evento.PainelAjuda: Events with their own script. Rounds count from the trigger — fire it when it happens at the table.

Marcador.Ajuda: Drag the point onto the map: the marker starts GM-only and lights up for players once the point is no longer hidden.
Marcador.SemCena: Open the map scene before placing the marker.
Marcador.SemPersonagem: Pick a character to act from this marker.
Marcador.IrAoMarcador: Center the map on the marker
Marcador.SemMarcadorNaCena: This marker is not on the open scene.
Marcador.CliqueNoMapa: Clique no mapa onde o marcador de «{nome}» deve ficar (Esc cancela). Depois, na camada de notas, arraste para ajustar.

Aventuras.Explicacao: The adventure text belongs to the book, and the Community License does not allow redistributing it. Pick the playtest PDF you already own: the system reads the text here in the browser, builds the acts and stores them in this world's compendium, ready to import. The file goes nowhere. The art comes in the publisher's zips, requested when importing.
Aventuras.Montado: Built from this PDF — ready to import
Aventuras.NoMundo: Stored in the world — ready to import
Aventuras.ErroLeitura: Could not read that file as a PDF.

Resumo.ato-i: {pontos} points of interest, {linhas} clue rows, {desafios} challenges, curse over {rodadas} rounds, {itens} table items
Resumo.ato-ii: {pontos} points of interest, {linhas} clue rows, {desafios} challenges, {leituras} tool readings

Aventuras.Problemas: Check: {n} warning(s) — the text and what the book prints don't fully agree; check the book

Motivo.trecho: Could not find Act I in this PDF. Is it the Ordem Paranormal 2 playtest book?
Motivo.ausente: This PDF does not include Act II — it only exists in the full playtest PDF.

Aventuras.MenuAjuda: Pick the playtest PDF and the system builds Act I (and Act II, if the PDF includes it) in this world's compendium.
Aventuras.ArtesFaltam: Art: {faltam} of {total} files missing from the world folder — it's the publisher's {zip}

Licenca.Aviso: This is unofficial content, published under the Ordem Paranormal Community License. Contains AI-generated material: the code is written with AI assistance; the texts are the author's.

BoasVindas.Versao: Unofficial Foundry VTT system for the Ordem Paranormal RPG 2 alpha playtest — version {versao}.

Traz.ficha: Character sheet and dice engine: d4→d12 ladder, two dice added, high/low result, criticals and critical failures with the book's table.
Traz.investigacao: Investigation scenes: points of interest with the Skill · DC · Information table, Examine, Interact, Recap, Share, mental overload and the GM panel.
Traz.desafios: Access challenges (Break, Unlock, Hack, Hold) and the ten Ordo Realitas tools, with the Portable Lab and the Modified Radio in their own windows.
Traz.compendios: {n} rules compendiums: abilities, callings and tools. Pregens, scene, handouts and soundtrack come with each act's adventure.

BoasVindas.AventurasTitulo: The adventures come from your PDF
BoasVindas.AventurasTexto: The text of the acts belongs to the book, and the Community License does not allow redistributing it. Pick the playtest PDF you already own: the system reads the text here in the browser, builds each act as an adventure and stores it in this world's compendium, ready to import. The free PDF is enough for Act I.
BoasVindas.AtoII: The art comes in the publisher's zips: Act I's is the free pack on the website; Act II's comes with the Arquivos Secretos subscription — and Act II only exists in the full PDF. The system asks for the zip when importing. Subscribing is what keeps the playtest alive.
BoasVindas.Apoiar: Support the publisher — Ordem Paranormal store
BoasVindas.NaoOficial: Fan-made, with no affiliation with the rights holders of Ordem Paranormal RPG; the book's content belongs to them.
BoasVindas.MostrarAoEntrar: Show this screen when entering the world
BoasVindas.MenuAjuda: What the system brings, where the adventures come from, the official links and the Community License.

Atalhos.PainelDica: Opens and closes the investigation panel.
Atalhos.AcoesDica: Opens and closes the character's actions window: the selected token's, else yours.
Atalhos.SemPersonagem: Choose a character, or select their token, to open the actions.

Ferramentas.ListandoMundo: Showing every access challenge in the world.
Ferramentas.SemDesafios: No access challenges. Create one or import an adventure.

Config.MostrarDica: Shows the floating bar with Request check, Opposed check, Access challenges and Import adventure (GM only). Shortcut: Shift+G.

Ferramentas.ExcluirConfirma: Permanently delete {nome}? It is also removed from investigations.

Destrancar.CancelarConfirma: End this challenge? The window closes for players.
Destrancar.DestrancadaTexto: The lock was opened. Access is free.
Destrancar.Superado: Challenge cleared in {rodadas} round(s) ({tentativas}/{max} total attempts).
Destrancar.AguardeRodada: Waiting for the GM to start the next round.
Destrancar.SoParticipante: Only the participant's owner can try.
Destrancar.CardTexto: {nome} will try to unlock. Click to open the challenge window.
Destrancar.SemJogadorOnline: No player owning the participant is online. The window opens when they click the chat card.

Ferramentas.OpostoProntidaoDica: Spend 2 SP (Readiness ability) to reroll one die on this side.

Pavor.NadaConsumido: O pavor não anulou nenhum dado.
Pavor.Aplicado: {nome} está com um dado de pavor ({dado}). Em todo teste ele rola junto, não soma e anula os resultados menores que ele; se anular todos, é falha crítica.
Pavor.Ajuda: Aplique ou remova o dado de pavor de cada personagem. Ele rola junto em todo teste, não soma e anula os resultados menores que ele (anulou todos: falha crítica). Tirou 1: o pavor termina. Receber de novo: sobe um passo.
Pavor.Pergunta: {nome} está com dado de pavor {dado} ({pd} PD). Antes de rolar, escolha:
Pavor.Controlou: {nome} gasta 1 PD e controla o pavor: agora é {dado}.
Pavor.Abracou: {nome} gasta 5 PD e abraça o pavor: o {dado} vira dado bônus neste teste.
Pavor.Venceu: O dado de pavor de {nome} tirou 1: o medo termina.
Pavor.AgoraRole: {nome} já viu os próprios dados. Agora, obrigatoriamente, role o dado de pavor ({dado}) antes da soma.
Pavor.Lembrete: Os dados que tirarem menos que o dado de pavor são anulados. Se anular todos, é falha crítica.
Pavor.RolarNormalTexto: Rola o teste; depois, o dado de pavor ({dado}) anula os resultados menores.
Pavor.ControlarTexto: Gasta 1 PD: o dado de pavor reduz um passo, para {dado}.
Pavor.AbracarTexto: Gasta 5 PD: o dado de pavor vira um dado bônus neste teste e o pavor acaba.
Pavor.JaMinimo: O dado de pavor já está no mínimo (d4).

Marcas.Ajuda: Lesões e traumas entram sozinhos ao rolar nas tabelas; os modificadores (−1, −2…) são somados ao total dos testes. O mestre remove um trauma quando ele é curado.

Tabela.Repetida: Já possui este resultado: role novamente.

Morte.Texto: {ator} está moribundo. Teste de {pericia} contra DT {dt}.
Morte.Consequencia: Crítico: recupera 1 PV. Sucesso: segue moribundo. Falha: tabela de Lesões. Falha crítica: morre.

Resultado.Critico: {ator} recupera 1 PV e se recupera de inconsciente e moribundo.
Resultado.Sucesso: {ator} resiste, mas segue inconsciente e moribundo.
Resultado.Falha: {ator} sofre uma lesão: role na tabela de Lesões.

Equilibrio.Inicio: {nome} começa a travessia com {n} dado(s) de equilíbrio (d4), metade da Acrobacia {dado}.
Equilibrio.EscolhaSoma: Some o {valor} a um dos dados.
Equilibrio.Regra: A cada rodada, rola 2d10: iguais ou com 1 de diferença, equilibra; senão, cai. Começa com dados de equilíbrio (d4) iguais à metade da Acrobacia; caindo, pode rolar um e somar a um dos d10. Os gastos não voltam até o fim da travessia.

Relacoes.Ajuda: Nome da pessoa, grau da relação (clique nos círculos), como o personagem chama essa relação e uma descrição curta.
Relacoes.Beneficio1: +1d6 em um teste ligado à pessoa; ao ajudá-la, fornece +1d6 além do aumento de passo.
Relacoes.Beneficio2: +1d8 em um teste ligado à pessoa; ao ajudá-la, +1d8; gastar uma ação para motivá-la: ela recupera 2d4 PD.
Relacoes.Beneficio3: +1d12 em um teste ligado à pessoa; ao ajudá-la, +1d12; motivá-la recupera 2d6 PD; se ela estiver em perigo, uma ação extra no turno para ajudá-la.
Relacoes.InvocadaDica: Cada relação só pode ser invocada uma vez por missão. Desmarque ao começar uma missão nova.
Relacoes.Invocar: Invocar uma relação: descreva o que sente pela pessoa e como isso o ajuda a perseverar, e escolha um benefício do grau. Cada relação, uma vez por missão.
Relacoes.DescricaoExemplo: Ex.: Não tem medo do lobo, ao contrário do resto da vila.

Armadura.Pergunta: {nome} vai sofrer {dano} de dano e tem {pontos} ponto(s) de armadura. Gastar 1 ponto (ação livre) para reduzir o dano em 10?
Armadura.Regra: Os itens equipados fornecem pontos de armadura. Ao sofrer dano, gaste 1 ponto (ação livre) para reduzir esse dano em 10. Pontos gastos não voltam neste playtest.

Declaracao.Titulo: Defina a sua ação para o próximo turno
Declaracao.Ajuda: Escolha em que fase seu personagem age: Geral (qualquer ação, exceto ataques), Distância ou Corpo a corpo.
Declaracao.ConfigDica: Tempo da janela de declaração aberta a cada rodada de combate.

Efeitos.Ajuda: Clique numa condição para aplicar ou remover. As mesmas condições aparecem no HUD do token.

Poder.AnaliseAjuda: Você tem {n} marcador(es) de análise: cada um muda um dado em +1 ou −1.
Poder.MentoriaAjuda: Mentoria: você pode trocar um dado por {ra}.
Poder.MentoriaSucesso: {nome} pode trocar um dado do próximo teste por {ra} (rolagem alta do mentor).
Poder.GuardiaUso: {nome} gasta 2 PD e se coloca na frente: passa a ser o alvo do ataque.
Poder.AntecipacaoUso: {nome} spends 2 PD on Tactical Anticipation: gets an extra turn before everyone and still acts in the declared phase.
Poder.LoboMachucado: O lobo de {nome} tirou 1 e se machucou: não ajuda mais até o fim da cena.
Poder.PlanoPergunta: Você tem {n} d6 do Plano Estratégico. Quantos usar neste teste?
Poder.PlanoFalhou: O plano de {nome} não se sustentou.
Poder.PlanoSucesso: Plano de {nome}: o grupo todo recebe {n} d6 bônus para usar até o fim da cena.
Poder.CurandeiroSemAlvo: Nenhum aliado disponível (cada um só pode ser curado uma vez por cena).
Poder.ArsenalPergunta: Qual preparado usar? Cada um é de uso único.

Arsenal.tonicoTexto: aumento de passo no Físico por uma cena.
Arsenal.vespaTexto: Sobrevivência como ataque à distância, dano RA+1.
Arsenal.tonicoUso: {alvo} bebe o tônico: Físico aumenta um passo até o fim da cena.
Arsenal.vespaAcertou: O pote acerta {alvo}: {dano} de dano. Se sobreviver, perde a próxima ação espantando as vespas.

Poder.ProntidaoDica: Prontidão: gaste 2 PD para rolar novamente um dado (não 1) deste teste. Uma vez por rodada.
Poder.ProntidaoJaUsou: Prontidão já foi usada nesta rodada.
Poder.ProntidaoSemDado: Nenhum dado pode ser rolado de novo (resultados 1 não contam).
Poder.ProntidaoPergunta: {nome} gasta 2 PD. Qual dado rolar de novo?
Poder.ProntidaoNota: Prontidão de {nome}: um dado foi de {antes} para {depois}.
Poder.ProntidaoOposto: {nome} spends 2 SP to reroll one of {alvo}'s dice. Which die?
Poder.ProntidaoMorto: A dead character cannot use Readiness.
Poder.AnaliseNota: {nome} spent {pontos} of analysis to turn a ({de}) into a ({para}).
Poder.MentoriaNota: {nome} used Mentoring: swapped the die ({de}) for the mentor's ({para}).
Poder.MentoriaRecusada: {nome} did not use Mentoring: kept their own dice (the mentor's {valor} was not used).
Poder.AntecipacaoSoNoInicio: Tactical Anticipation only works in the first round of a combat, once per combat.
Poder.AntecipacaoDica: Spend 2 PD: you act once before everyone (Anticipation phase) and again in your declared phase. First round only.
Poder.InstintoNota: Dice step increased by the Ability: {habilidade}.
Poder.GuardiaPergunta: {atacante} is about to attack {alvo} (total {total}). {guardia} may spend 2 PD to become the target of this attack.
Poder.GuardiaLembrete: Once per round, with the ally within short range.
Poder.GuardiaTrocou: Guardian: {guardia} steps in front of {alvo} and becomes the target.
Poder.GuardiaTarde: {alvo} already answered this attack: the Guardian can no longer change the target.
Poder.AjudaNota: Dice step increased (+{passos}) thanks to {nome}'s help.

PericiasMundo.MenuAjuda: Hide, rename or create skills (e.g. Occultism as Witchcraft in a medieval campaign).
PericiasMundo.Ajuda: Uncheck to hide a skill from sheets and test lists (its data is kept). Type a name to rename it at this table. Saving reloads everyone.
PericiasMundo.AptidoesAjuda: Hide or rename the built-in fields, or create new ones: they are added to every sheet with the chosen die.

CriticoExtra.JaRolado: The critical die was already rolled for this test.
CriticoExtra.Dica: Rolls one more die (the largest of the critical) and adds it to the total and damage.

EfeitosMundo.MenuAjuda: Hide or rename the system conditions and create your own effects, with steps, damage per round, duration, a test to end it or code.
EfeitosMundo.Ajuda: Effects show on the sheet's Effects tab and on the token HUD. Saving reloads everyone.
EfeitosMundo.PassosDica: Negative lowers (−1 = one step down), positive raises.
EfeitosMundo.Dano: Damage at the end of each round

Duracao.cena: Until the end of the scene

EfeitosMundo.RodadasDica: How many rounds (only for 'Number of rounds').
EfeitosMundo.TesteTitulo: Test to end it (at the end of the round)
EfeitosMundo.CodigoAjuda: Runs on the GM's computer when the effect is applied, removed and at the end of each round. Variables: ator, efeito (id), evento ('aplicar' | 'remover' | 'fimDeRodada'), definicao. Only use code you trust.
EfeitosMundo.TesteConvite: {ator} may test {pericia} (DC {dt}) to shake off the effect.
EfeitosMundo.CodigoErro: Error in the code of effect {nome}: {erro}
EfeitosMundo.ResetDica: GM only: resets the uses of limited abilities (Arsenal, Readiness, Healer, Wolf…).
EfeitosMundo.ResetSoMestre: Only the GM can reset uses.
EfeitosMundo.ResetPergunta: Reset the limited ability uses of {nome}? Arsenal preparations, this round's Readiness, Healer targets, the hurt wolf and actions used this scene become available again.
EfeitosMundo.ResetAviso: Warning: this action may only be taken with the GM's authorization.
EfeitosMundo.ResetConfirma: Confirm the reset was authorized by the GM?
EfeitosMundo.ResetFeito: {nome}'s ability uses were reset by the GM.

Furtividade.EncerrarPergunta: End the stealth scene? The vignette goes away and hiding dice no longer count.
Furtividade.RolarAcaoDica: Rolls 1d10 on the Creature Actions table. High results are better for the characters.
Furtividade.ArrasteCriatura: Drag creatures from the sidebar here.
Furtividade.ArrastePersonagem: Drag the characters from the sidebar here.
Furtividade.Ninguem: The GM has not added anyone to the scene yet.
Furtividade.OcultarDica: Hide or reveal the creature's identity to players
Furtividade.TesteEsconderijoAjuda: Usually Stealth, but the description may call for another skill (Acrobatics, Vigor, Survival…). The rolled dice become your hiding dice.
Furtividade.EsconderDica: Stealth. On a success, a rolled die becomes a hiding die. The DC rises +3 each time you use it.
Furtividade.DistrairDica: Deception. On a success, a rolled die becomes a hiding die for you or an ally. The DC rises +3 each time the group uses it.
Furtividade.ChamarDica: Give one of your dice to an ally and discard another.
Furtividade.ChamativaDica: Running or making noise: discard a hiding die.

Tabela.1: The GM says two numbers. Characters discard hiding dice with those numbers.
Tabela.2: Breath on the neck! A creature gets very close to a character.
Tabela.3: The creatures search all characters, rolling 1d10.
Tabela.4: The creatures search all characters, rolling 2d8.
Tabela.5: The creatures search all characters, rolling 3d6.
Tabela.6: The creatures search all characters, rolling 1d8.
Tabela.7: The creatures search all characters, rolling 2d6.
Tabela.8: A creature leaps toward a character: 1d12, 2d10 or 3d8, by their highest hiding die.
Tabela.9: A creature searches a character: 1d10, 2d8 or 3d6, by their highest hiding die.
Tabela.10: The creatures stop for a moment. Nobody is searched this round.

Furtividade.DoisNumerosAjuda: Choose two numbers. Anyone with hiding dice of those values discards them.
Furtividade.SoproAjuda: Stay still without a sound (lose 2d6 SP) or move away (lose a hiding die)?
Furtividade.SoproPerdeuPD: {nome} stays still and loses {n} SP from the tension.

Alvo.2: A creature gets very close to {nome}!

Furtividade.VinhetaDica: Darkens the screen edges with fog while a hiding scene is active (this computer only).
Furtividade.JaAgiuDica: Check when the character has acted this round. Clears itself on the next round.
Furtividade.Aguardando: Already acted. Waiting for the round to end.
Furtividade.OcultoDoMestre: Hiding test: the dice are shown to players only.
Furtividade.TabelaAjuda: Ask a player to roll 1d10. High results are better for the characters.
Furtividade.AguardandoMestre: Waiting for the GM to run the action.
Furtividade.NinguemEscondido: Nobody is hidden to be searched.
Furtividade.SorteioAjuda: Only characters still hidden are included.
Furtividade.SoproNaoEhVoce: Only the one the creature reached ({nome}) can choose here.

Loucura.Dica: With SP below half, the screen edges darken and crack, stronger as SP drops (this computer only).
Loucura.Vinculados: {n} character token(s) linked to their sheet: the token bar and the sheet are now the same.

Criatura.RolarAtaque: Strike: picks the target, asks whether they defend and rolls the attack
Criatura.RemoverPergunta: Remove this entry from the creature sheet?
Criatura.DadosInvalidos: Invalid attack dice: {dados}. Use something like 2d6 or d8+d6.
Criatura.ImportarDica: Fills this creature from a Ficha-*.json file. Replaces attacks, abilities and skills.
Criatura.ImportarTipo: This file is for a {tipo} actor, not a creature.

Perseguicao.Corte: End of round {rodada}: at least {pa} AP
Perseguicao.CabecasDica: Start of round: draws two characters. The first takes 1d6 HP (bite or venom), the second 1d6 SP (the many-eyed head).
Perseguicao.ProximaDica: Applies the round cut (3: 15 AP, 4: 20 AP, 5: 30 AP) and moves on.
Perseguicao.FolegoDica: Breath dice: bonus d6 on chase tests (up to 2 per test).
Perseguicao.AvancarDica: Athletics (DC 10): success gains the high roll in AP, failure the low roll. Other skills only once each.
Perseguicao.RecuperarDica: Recover two breath dice. No advance.
Perseguicao.SacrificioDica: Stop running to hinder the pursuer: no advance, but allies get +1d6 on their advance test this round.
Perseguicao.OutraDica: Use an ability or item, at the GM's discretion. No advance this round.
Perseguicao.AvisouVala: {nome} shouts a warning about the ditch! The others get +1 step to notice it.
Perseguicao.Sacrificou: {nome} stops running to hinder {perseguidor}: +1d6 on the allies advance this round.
Perseguicao.Empate: {nomes} are tied below {corte} AP: opposed test between them (Athletics by default, or what they describe).
Perseguicao.NinguemAlcancado: Everyone passed {corte} AP. Nobody was caught.
Perseguicao.PericiaAjuda: {pericia} always works. Other skills only once each, if you justify them.
Perseguicao.ValaAjuda: There is a hidden hole on the way. Test Perception or Survival (DC 10). On a failure, the advance takes two step reductions.
Perseguicao.ValaAvisado: An ally warned you: +1 step on this test.
Perseguicao.ValaPassou: {nome} spots the ditch and leaps over it.
Perseguicao.EsforcoPerdeu: {nome} pushes to the limit and loses {n} HP.
Perseguicao.HabilitadaDica: Turns on the chase panel. Leave it off if another GM uses the system first, so nobody sees the adventure 2 scene.
Perseguicao.SomDica: Racing heartbeat and heavy breathing during the chase (this computer only).
Perseguicao.AvisouEvento: {nome} shouts a warning: {evento}! The others get a step increase to notice it.
Perseguicao.EventoAvisado: An ally warned you: +{n} step on the test.
Perseguicao.EventoFalha: On a failure, the advance takes {n} step(s).
Perseguicao.SeFalharEvento: ({n} steps if you fail the event)
Perseguicao.MarcoDica: End of round {rodada}: at least {pa} AP
Perseguicao.ChamadaPadrao: Choose a way to avoid the danger:
Perseguicao.OpostoSoDois: Only with two tied. With three or more, decide manually.
Perseguicao.CliqueQuemProsseguiu: Click the portrait of whoever got further ahead. The other one is caught.
Perseguicao.CliqueQuemProsseguiuVarios: Click, one by one, the portraits of those who got ahead. The last one left is caught.
Perseguicao.ResolvaEmpate: Resolve the tie in chat before moving on.
Perseguicao.MotivoOposto: Chase tie: who got further ahead?
Perseguicao.PerguntaEmpate: You are tied. Whisper to the GM what your character does to get ahead (e.g. betray your companion and push them into the ditch).
Perseguicao.SemEmpate: There is no chase tie waiting for a decision.
Perseguicao.VencedorForaDoEmpate: The winner of this test is not among the tied characters.
Perseguicao.EmpatePendente: A tie from this round is waiting for a decision in chat. Discard it and calculate the end of the round again?

CenaConfig.MetaDica: AP needed to reach safety at the end of the chase.
CenaConfig.OutrasUmaVez: Other skills can only be used once each
CenaConfig.Folego: Use breath dice (half Vigor in d6)
CenaConfig.MarcosAjuda: At the end of the given round, whoever has fewer AP than the minimum and the lowest score is caught.
CenaConfig.EventosAjuda: On the first advance action with the given AP, the character faces the event: reads the description and tests one of the skills. Use {nome} for the character name.
CenaConfig.GatilhoDica: Triggers on the first advance action with this AP or more.
CenaConfig.PericiasEvento: Skills that can test (Ctrl+click for several)
CenaConfig.Avisavel: Whoever passed can warn the others
CenaConfig.InicioRodadaAjuda: Each attack draws a different character. Use {nome} and {n} (the damage) in the text.
CenaConfig.DtBaseDica: Hide and Distract start at this DC.
CenaConfig.DanoEncontradoDica: Rolled at the end of each round for each found character.
CenaConfig.TabelaAjuda: Choose what each result does. Empty text uses the default text.
CenaConfig.FormulaDica: Search everyone: one formula (2d8). Search one: three formulas, for highest die d12, d10 and d8 or lower (1d12, 2d10, 3d8).
CenaConfig.SomDica: Plays for everyone while this chase is active. Each player can still turn it off in their settings.

Sussurro.Placeholder: E.g.: You hear a voice from a nearby alley...
Sussurro.ArrasteItens: Optional: drag items to offer the player
Sussurro.SemConteudo: Write a message or offer an item.
Sussurro.SemJogadores: There are no players in the world.
Sussurro.ResponderPlaceholder: Write what you want to do. Only the GM will read it.
Sussurro.SemDestino: Could not find the character or the item.

EfeitosCena.Dica: Name (or id) of the scene that turns on FX Bus shake, blur and smear on the screen of everyone on it (players and GM). Leave empty to turn it off. Requires the FX Bus module.

Dados3D.Dica: Everyone (GM and players) uses the same Dice So Nice finish: Pristine material, Signika font, high quality. Each die takes its user's color. Changes made in the Dice So Nice window return to the standard on the next login.
Dados3D.Recarregue: 3D dice set to the table standard. Reload the page (F5) to see the new quality.

AcoesCombate.Dica: Read and run this character's combat actions: declares it in chat and triggers what depends on the action (Combat Reading, attack, maneuvers).
AcoesCombate.Ajuda: Execute declares the action in chat. Strike opens the attack; Defend keeps the character Defending until the next attack against them this round (a window asks before the roll) and triggers Combat Reading; Aim, Feint and maneuvers ask for the target; Feint and maneuvers roll the test and the target resists from the card; falling and standing toggle Prone.
AcoesCombate.JaRespondido: This opposed test was already answered.

Efeito.Fintar: {nome} gets two step increases on the next attack against {alvo} (until the end of the next round).
Efeito.Agarrar: {alvo} is grappled: immobile, step reduction on attacks and attacks only with small weapons. {nome} has a hand busy and is overloaded.
Efeito.Quebrar: {nome} hits an item of {alvo} and deals the attack damage to the object.

EfeitoForte.Derrubar: Won by 5 or more: {alvo} takes {rb} impact damage (RB).
EfeitoForte.Desarmar: Won by 5 or more: {nome} may take the item (free hand) or throw it.
EfeitoForte.Empurrar: Won by 5 or more: {alvo} is off-balance (step reduction on the next test).

Defesa.Pergunta: {atacante} is about to attack {alvo} with {ataque} ({alcance}). Defend? The test is opposed to the attack; winning, you take no damage (and deal none).
Defesa.Ajuda: Defending: this round's declaration is spent on this attack. Dodge: once per round, free action. Skip: the attack is against DC 7.
Defesa.Aguardando: Waiting for {nome} to decide whether to defend…
Defesa.JaRolou: The defense for this attack was already rolled.
